title: Git, integration-on-disk and artifact inventory adapters
description:
Objective: land the production enumerators for the Git/integration-on-disk class and the artifact object/staging class, registered into the recovery-inventory port registry. Slice 3 of 3 from task-0325dcf7ee744123b40cf583230c7b6a, split by architect-d46fcb95 on human direction 2026-08-09.

TWO hard dependencies, both real:
1. task-00956ac383784e81b0345bbf09256323 (Recovery-inventory contract and coverage protocol) - owns the class set, item shape, coverage proof, INVENTORY_ADAPTER layer and the port registry.
2. task-f6c9011b24634de7b22ad10a26579883 (Git ref and artifact object enumeration capabilities) - supplies the enumerators this slice calls, WHICH DO NOT EXIST TODAY.

*** WHY DEPENDENCY 2 EXISTS. Measured symbol by symbol at 2026-08-09 by architect-d46fcb95: GitObserver (packages/runner/src/scope/scope-contract.ts) declares exactly headCommit(), statusPorcelainV2(), lsFilesTracked(), lsFilesIgnored(), submodulePaths() - there is NO branch or ref enumeration, and grep for for-each-ref/show-ref/--branches/refs/heads over packages/runner/src returns ZERO. ArtifactStore declares exactly stageArtifact(), verifyArtifact(), deleteArtifact() and ArtifactFsPort has no directory listing - grep for readdir/listObjects/listStaging returns ZERO outside runtime-entrypoint.test.ts. The parent task's instruction to "reuse the hermetic Git observer and artifact store" is therefore not satisfiable as written; the capability is genuinely absent. Do NOT close that gap by reimplementing enumeration inside this module or inside a test - wait for task-f6c9011b. ***

MEASURED PRESENT: the hermetic Git boundary itself exists - packages/runner/src/scope/scope-git.ts (createNodeGitObserver, hermeticGitEnvironment, MAX_SCOPE_OBSERVATION_BYTES) with shell:false / bounded maxBuffer / timeout / windowsHide discipline - as does the artifact store (createArtifactStore, createNodeArtifactFs, verifyArtifact) over its <root>/objects/<sha256> layout. This slice composes those, extended by dependency 2.

Deliverable: packages/runner/src/recovery-inventory/git-inventory.ts (+ .js bridge) and artifact-inventory.ts (+ .js bridge) plus focused tests, each registering itself as a class enumerator through the contract slice's port registry.

NOT in scope: the contract, coverage protocol or aggregate (slice 1); provider/process/lock or workspace classes (slice 2); scheduler resource rows; adopt/quarantine decisions; project embargo; tests/fault.

Owned paths: packages/runner/src/recovery-inventory/git-inventory.{ts,js}, artifact-inventory.{ts,js}, their focused tests, and the two-line registration edit in the slice-1 aggregate. This slice does NOT edit index.ts or index-surface.test.ts - slice 1 owns the root seam.

Consumer (global rail Clause 1): daemon coordinator task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test
definitionOfDone: The Git/integration enumerator observes a real repository through the hermetic observer extended by task-f6c9011b, enumerating refs and the integration targets represented on disk, and binds every item to class, stable external identity, observed disposition facts and source proof digest; it never invokes git through a shell and never accepts a free-form command string.

The artifact enumerator lists objects and staging entries through the extended artifact store over its own <root>/objects/<sha256> layout and binds each item the same way; an entry whose name is not a valid content address is reported with a stable code rather than silently skipped.

An unavailable enumerator, a truncated or over-limit result, an absent repository or store root, and a missing negative proof each return RECOVERY_INVENTORY_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN at layer INVENTORY_ADAPTER with truth UNKNOWN; an empty listing is never proof of absence and partial items never upgrade the class to COMPLETE.

Enumeration order and digest are deterministic across path separators and locale on Windows, macOS and Linux; duplicate external identities and entries outside the exact project or recovery window refuse rather than merge or drop.

Focused tests build real temporary Git repositories and real artifact-store bytes rather than a reimplemented fixture authority, assert each covered class generated at least one coverage case with a non-zero asserted count, pin the exact code and INVENTORY_ADAPTER layer on every refusal, and mutation-check that the coverage handling is reddenable.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test exits 0, with any residual red attributed to foreign paths against a recorded merge-base baseline.
taskRails: Do not start until task-f6c9011b24634de7b22ad10a26579883 has landed the ref and object enumeration capabilities. Closing that gap inside this module, or inside a test helper, is exactly the reimplementation the project rails forbid.

A configured class requires complete enumeration or a verifiable negative proof; an empty listing, an absent directory, and an unreadable entry are three different facts and must carry three different answers.
These are external-effect boundaries: never invoke git through a shell, never accept a free-form command string, and keep every child bounded by maxBuffer, timeout and windowsHide.
Tests assert the exact stable reason code and the INVENTORY_ADAPTER layer, and assert non-zero generated class coverage.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; this cap is per file, not per task.

When this adapter task is planned, amend the stale 'two-line registration edit in the slice-1 aggregate' wording: export the adapter's frozen registration fragment from its own owned files and let daemon consumer task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa compose fragments. Do not edit recovery-inventory.ts or the @moe/runner root seam; task-00956ac owns them.
